description: This file defines the WebSocketDeflateStream class, a subclass of WebSocketStream, implementing permessage-deflate WebSocket extension with methods for reading, writing, inflating, deflating, and managing WebSocket frames, including handling compression states and callbacks.

classes.name: WebSocketDeflateStream
classes.description: A subclass of WebSocketStream that handles permessage-deflate compression extension, managing frame deflation/inflation, and maintaining compression states.

methods.name: WebSocketDeflateStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing the deflate stream with underlying stream, parameters, and predictor.

methods.name: ReadFrames
methods.description: Reads WebSocket frames, possibly inflating compressed frames.

methods.name: WriteFrames
methods.description: Writes WebSocket frames, possibly deflating frames before sending.

methods.name: OnReadComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of asynchronous read operations.

methods.name: OnMessageStart
methods.description: Handles start of a message frame.

methods.name: AppendCompressedFrame
methods.description: Appends a compressed frame to frames to write.

methods.name: AppendPossiblyCompressedMessage
methods.description: Appends a message that may be compressed.

methods.name: InflateAndReadIfNecessary
methods.description: Inflates frames if necessary and reads.
